data.title: 阿蕾克希亚 · 雪夜后巷的执着挥剑
data.description: 飘着细雪的砖石小巷尽头，单薄的制服下身姿挺拔。阿蕾克希亚握紧佩剑横于胸前，银发迎风舞动，红眸在雪光中显露出誓不屈服的坚决。
data.location: snow-covered narrow medieval cobblestone alleyway at night
data.action: holding drawn rapier across her guard stance, silver ponytail whipping in snowy wind, white breath puffing in cold air
data.lighting: cool bluish street lantern light reflecting off falling snow and polished blade
data.mood: solitary stubborn courage, unyielding resolve, poignant chilly romance
data.promptProse: In a snowy night alley, silver ponytail Alexia stands resolute holding her drawn sword as snowflakes drift around her.
data.animaCaption: Alexia standing resolute with her sword in the snowy alleyway.
